## CAO PHASE A — SUCCESSOR RECEIPT CONTRACT VERIFIED; INDEPENDENT REVIEW COMPLETE

**Disposition.** Three fresh, separate reviewers approved artifact **13715911121** for a separately identified successor to the missing F1 receipt. This comment records the review. Issuance, verification of the issued bytes and published-head equivalence remain subsequent gates.

**Live state.** PR #54 is open, Draft and unmerged at `fc33e21153756a0f694590e55fc607c8b0fb30e4`, Git tree `768a4768d1e7203cf16c3834939498f78504e052`. The branch checkout matches both objects. F2 was the latest prior conversation checkpoint. We found no published successor pointer, inventory or review on this head or in the PR comments, reviews or threads. [Run 42700963367, attempt 1](https://github.com/DanTrackedFR/chief-accounting-officer/actions/runs/42700963367), job 129445232197: GitHub records successful discovery, regression execution and artifact upload, then failure at the separate acceptance-reporting step. The original execution record remains acceptance-pending. The [genuine ZIP](https://github.com/DanTrackedFR/chief-accounting-officer/actions/runs/42700963367/artifacts/13715911121) was available and its 2,135,525 downloaded bytes matched the live GitHub digest.

### Frozen production contract and successor identity

- [Issuer and inventory verifier](https://github.com/DanTrackedFR/chief-accounting-officer/blob/fc33e21153756a0f694590e55fc607c8b0fb30e4/skills/presumed-sources/receipt_integrity.py#L29-L86): `seal_inventory(root, manifest_path, outer_log, review, output, 'release', extra_files=...)` seals existing evidence after actual execution and review; it runs no tests. It refuses an existing inventory output and returns the schema-v2 pointer data. The issuing caller must write the pointer exclusively. `verify_inventory` requires the manifest digest, every file in its directory, both start maps, exact suite sidecars, original command/shard logs, and both exact attestation roles. Extra files are individually hashed, including the genuine ZIP when supplied. GitHub identity/digest and reviewer authority are separate checks; file hashing alone confers neither.
- The release review role is **exactly** `manifest_path.parent / 'receipt-review.md'`. The outer log is determined by the unchanged hosted `manifest['attempt']`. The [release verifier](https://github.com/DanTrackedFR/chief-accounting-officer/blob/fc33e21153756a0f694590e55fc607c8b0fb30e4/skills/presumed-sources/verify_release.py#L151-L195) permits a selected manifest under `build4/release/`; it does not require its directory basename to equal the hosted attempt ID. This permits a byte-identical evidence copy in a new directory with a fresh sibling review. Merely renaming or redirecting the review beside the original manifest fails the role check.
- **Selected names for the next assignment.** Under `build4/release/`, use directory `presumed-sources-evidence-42700963367-1-successor-1/`, inventory `presumed-sources-inventory-42700963367-1-successor-1-v2.json` and pointer `presumed-sources-accepted-42700963367-1-successor-1-v2.json`. These are proposed unused names. The contract requires distinct unused paths, an external inventory, schema **2**, purpose **release**, and a pointer under the release namespace. The [PR workflow selector](https://github.com/DanTrackedFR/chief-accounting-officer/blob/fc33e21153756a0f694590e55fc607c8b0fb30e4/.github/workflows/cao-presumed-sources.yml#L78-L94) additionally requires a direct child matching `[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+-v2.json` and its SHA-256. `successor-1` identifies the issuance, not a new execution or schema.
- Preserve all 298 original members at their archived paths, verifying any existing file before reuse. The single overlap with the frozen tree is the historical pointer and its bytes match. Copy the hosted attempt subtree byte-for-byte into the new directory. Keep the hosted manifest, attempt ID, source, gate plan, execution status and every embedded path unchanged. Use the copied manifest as `manifest_path`, its fresh sibling review as `review` and the genuine original outer log. Bind **all original member paths**, the unchanged ZIP and immutable provenance via `extra_files`. This retains both the copied and canonical manifest bindings, along with every source of execution evidence.
- Both explicit verifier entrypoints support this layout by contract: `python skills/presumed-sources/verify_release.py --pointer "$P"` and `python build4/verify_release.py --pointer "$P"`. [Build4 delegates to the same production validator](https://github.com/DanTrackedFR/chief-accounting-officer/blob/fc33e21153756a0f694590e55fc607c8b0fb30e4/build4/verify_release.py#L18-L35). Their actual PASS for a successor can be established only after issuance. No production code, fixture, workflow or schema change is needed.

### Independent review performed for this checkpoint

| Fresh reviewer | Checks personally performed and conclusion |
|---|---|
| Engineering (`/root/engineering`) | **Approve.** Hashed and CRC-checked 298 unique ZIP members. Reconciled discovery, 23 suite sidecars, module sidecars, 34 command log bindings and orchestration shard logs. All 4,013 distinct IDs were scheduled, executed and passed; zero failures, errors, skips or unexecuted IDs. Ordered suite populations matched the pinned 4,011-identity ledger plus its two named corrections; all 118 mandatory identities passed (63 historical and 55 Phase A). Frozen production population validation passed. Rebuilt both complete input maps and checked the Git blob bindings. Regenerated the production HTTP proof at seeds 109 and 971. Both matched the selected proof. |
| Accounting (`/root/accounting`) | **Approve.** Independently reconciled the 23 suites, 4,013 passing IDs, 118 mandatory IDs and 34 log hashes/exit codes. Both fresh HTTP proofs reproduced closing asset cost **648,000**, depreciation **64,800**, closing accumulated depreciation **64,800**, and AP invoices **1,550**, within supplied-file scope, including retry and restart agreement. Reviewed the frozen assertions for the **2,400** proposed depreciation and **260,000** comparison variance. Verified the historical ledgers and the investment-property and government-grants preservation checks. |
| Release governance (`/root/governance`) | **Approve successor eligibility.** Reviewed the frozen issuer, both verifier paths, actual archive and published C/D/E/F1/F2 provenance. Verified the 464 Python and 2,745 governed execution-input maps against their archived start maps, manifest and tested Git blobs. Zero archive paths intersect either map. Production preservation verified 8,912 historical entries and the separate overlapping 7,963 accepted-main entries (7,959 active originals plus four archived infrastructure originals). Verified workflow bytes and the distinct review-directory requirement. |

[C](#issuecomment-6759314160) recorded the earlier raw unittest-log verification. [D/E](#issuecomment-6759348156) recorded the original independent approvals, issuance, verifier passes and reuse. [F1](#issuecomment-6760087694) recorded byte recovery and verifier passes on the original receipt. [F2](#issuecomment-6776278969) documented subsequent loss of those bytes. Those prior actions are historical findings. The fresh reviewers above speak only for this successor eligibility review.

### Evidence fingerprints

| Object | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| GitHub ZIP | `03f2b4fde57e7b58d79d6ef645ed820adb5a9674e685c5be3f4be4b884ff5dea` |
| Hosted release-regression.json | `7788dc85216a82e8b01aee7da1a56867e676935a2a08014b0c1ce24919b6a010` |
| Hosted execution.json | `a0b6f7943bcc43b49bd3c3848b3e0858a801d0eaf57c42c577ff7a29060c59e9` |
| Corrected workflow | `8fafe00b4e1c7a7da139290a3bb0b01958a02123ec3cc477fe778a91a088abd9` |
| Discovery | `c5e7285002f28ed79f46e47cefc43039bbb683bd8eb452fcfd4ffff3a91434dd` |
| Canonical predecessor population ledger | `9d05d7c782169398060fb49bab1735b731f0a337a66b9c880542af34801983df` |
| Start Python / execution-input maps | `e4767aa1f929bdf06225a47f095b6d6a639dceeacf3fd51ea9346694b9ff9de3` / `1300a9597314ad26f7af987d7078d85f4ea3f00bfd47a2a31dde51f56538c91c` |
| Selected deterministic HTTP proof | `b973931977a198aced1c01ce2d3eb9013892a7f9c87114049e46714a488eef5d` |

**Immutable historical reservations.** None of the downloaded members has any of these three digests. Only exact original bytes may occupy these paths, all relative to `build4/release/`.

| Reserved F1 path | Original SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `presumed-sources-accepted-42700963367-1-v2.json` | `6eff261234f0c321e849233123914809019f58d00a9c981f97af01d4119509bc` |
| `presumed-sources-inventory-42700963367-1-v2.json` | `f944283285334a5cf328fa21538dacb7175b072fd1b54b036b6e2661e3031ee4` |
| `presumed-sources-attempt-ci-42700963367-1/receipt-review.md` | `d817b95fcc61703fe1dc1b8a7ce60cf9b5c7bc06d6d5d23ed9361005770e9698` |

**Next assignment — controlled successor issuance and F2 publication.** Recheck PR head, comments, unused paths, ZIP digest and every member. Prepare the evidence layout above, record this checkpoint and the three fresh conclusions in the new review, and identify F1 separately. Seal the new external v2 inventory with the production issuer and exclusively create its explicit pointer. Run both unmodified verifiers on that pointer, reject a bad manifest digest in an isolated copy, and demonstrate explicit local reuse with a unique reuse attempt. Publish only reviewed evidence and provenance to the existing branch under the applicable workflow-trigger controls. From the actual publication head, enumerate the complete diff, recompute both entire maps, require exact equality with the frozen maps and their Git blob bindings, repeat both verifiers and historical checks, and publish hashes, exact head and results. These evidence destinations add no governed execution input under the frozen map builders; the publication commit will have its own Git tree. Keep strict equivalence to the tested inputs and stop on any difference. Hosted reuse and PR readiness remain separate assignments.

This checkpoint is the only publication in this review. No successor was issued, no acceptance files were published and no release workflow or regression was started.
